title: The triality of the twisted discrete trace formula for PGSO(8)
summary: In this paper, we establish the triality twisted trace formula for PGSO(8), including its discrete part, and obtain a coarse classification of its automorphic representations by combining the properties of triality. By comparing the standard trace formula for G_2 with the triality twisted trace formula for PGSO(8), we derive a corresponding coarse classification for automorphic representations of G_2.
